L29·N2054unmasked layer
Fires on the modifier/possessive token immediately preceding a body-part noun in anatomical or injury descriptions (e.g. "his **right** leg/arm", "**mid**-thigh", "in **my** calves"), rather than on the body-part word itself — which instead strongly suppresses it (lists like "bust, tummy, hips", "face, neck and chest").
